title: agent-prompts gate verdict
note: Declarative contract, not JSON Schema. tooling/check_gate_verdict.py implements it. Vocabulary follows standards/workflow-loop.md WL-09 and standards/verification-integrity.md VI-01..VI-13.

rules.verifier: must be non-empty and differ from implementer; 'self' requires an exemption and cannot carry pass; verifier_kind 'mechanical' requires verification_provenance with defined_by and authored_in_this_attempt=false (VI-02)
rules.pass: requires mode!=off, no open or waived high/medium finding, every check ran with exit 0 and fresh output, no stub artifact, every MUST criterion met, empty degraded, coverage.measured>=coverage.floor, at least one substantive capture
rules.fix: requires at least one open finding, an unmet or unverified MUST criterion, or a failing check
rules.hold: requires hold_reason from the enum: skipped-check, degraded, mode-off, exemption, or operator-wait (WL-09 `hold` = waiting for the operator or missing input)
rules.attempt: required, an integer; 0 or 1 at gate review, verify, acceptance or run (WL-08, VI-13); the round number at gate plan-review, where the bound is progress not a count (WL-15); above 1 elsewhere only on a halt with reason over-bound
rules.claims: each claim names an evidence id present in checks[].name, criteria[].id, artifacts[].path, or findings[].id
rules.checks: a skipped check carries skip_reason; a budget-killed check does not record exit 0; a pass needs a capture: command + exit + output_digest, or an ok artifact (VI-07)
rules.plan-review: requires the six WL-15 checks as criteria with a state each, a verifier that did not write the spec, coverage of every spec section the record declares, and no open or waived high/medium finding for a pass; a round whose CHANGED line repeats the previous one is halt with reason stalled
